title: Yonatan Sheida
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yevamot 122a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.122a.9), Rabbi Hanina said, “Yonatan Shida told me that they [the demons] have a reflection, but no reflection of a reflection.” [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Yevamot.122a.9.2) says he was a demon or was familiar with demons. Hyman considers the wording he cites in [Gittin 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.66a.9), “Yonatan my son told me,” an error.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Gittin wording is “Yonatan my son taught me.” [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1894&lang=en) records the form “Yonatan Shida taught me.”
